import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int m = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] aStr = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(aStr[i]);
        }

        List<Integer> part1 = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> part2 = new ArrayList<>();
        int half = n / 2;

        generatePart1(0, 0, a, m, part1, half);
        generatePart2(half, 0, a, m, part2, n);

        Set<Integer> setPart1 = new HashSet<>(part1);
        List<Integer> uniquePart1 = new ArrayList<>(setPart1);
        Collections.sort(uniquePart1);

        int max_value = 0;

        for (int val : part2) {
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(uniquePart1, m - val);
            if (index < 0) {
                index = -index - 1; // insertion point
            }
            if (index > 0) {
                int candidate_sum = uniquePart1.get(index - 1) + val;
                if (candidate_sum > max_value) {
                    max_value = candidate_sum;
                }
            } else {
                if (val > max_value) {
                    max_value = val;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_value);
    }

    private static void generatePart1(int i, int total, int[] a, int m, List<Integer> part1, int limit) {
        if (i == limit) {
            part1.add(total);
        } else {
            generatePart1(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, part1, limit);
            generatePart1(i + 1, total, a, m, part1, limit);
        }
    }

    private static void generatePart2(int i, int total, int[] a, int m, List<Integer> part2, int limit) {
        if (i == limit) {
            part2.add(total);
        } else {
            generatePart2(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m, a, m, part2, limit);
            generatePart2(i + 1, total, a, m, part2, limit);
        }
    }
}
